note.text: Real — the Connecticut DSS fiscal agent that runs the Medicaid Management Information System / CT Medical Assistance Program (CMAP, ctdssmap.com). Gainwell performs eligibility verification (270/271), DTR and PAS where prior authorization applies, and adjudicates and pays all dental claims (837D in, 835 out). It is the entity that actually administers the HUSKY plan operationally (claims/payment). There is no dental MCO in this model.
